scripts.//test:tooling: node:test suites for check-wiring and scaffold-module, including an end-to-end scaffold of two modules (one inline) through generate, check:wiring and tsc.
scripts.//generate: Both typegens (Studio schema + types, then the web query types) and a check that every web query got a type. Run after every schema or query edit.
scripts.generate: pnpm --filter studio run generate && pnpm --filter web run generate && pnpm run check:typegen
scripts.//dev: Starts both web (3000) and studio (3333) in parallel — comment out one filter or use `web:dev`/`studio:dev` to run only one.

pnpm.//overrides: magicast pin avoids the older transitive 0.2.x version pulled in by some Sanity tooling, which lacks the `parseExpression` API used downstream. Re-evaluate when removing — drop the override and run `pnpm why magicast` to confirm only ^0.3 versions remain.
pnpm.//peerDependencyRules: sanity-plugin-netlify@1.4.0 declares `sanity: ^3 || ^5`, so Sanity 6 trips an unmet-peer warning on every resolution step. Verified stale rather than real: the plugin imports only FormField, useColorScheme, useClient and definePlugin from `sanity`, all still exported by 6.x, and both apps build. Upstream PR jclusso/sanity-plugin-netlify#24 reports a FormField crash on Sanity >=5.17 (useDocumentDivergences threw without its context) — that path is dead on 6.16.0, where DocumentDivergencesContext defaults to `{enabled: false}` and FormNodeDivergenceDetail passes its children straight through. Scoped to this one edge so genuine peer warnings stay visible. Drop it once upstream widens the range — issues are disabled on that repo, so a PR is the only route. Separate pre-existing trait, verified as a cost rather than a defect: the plugin pins @sanity/ui ^2 and @sanity/icons ^3 as hard dependencies, so a second @sanity/ui major ships inside the Studio bundle. It is not a theming hazard — the plugin wraps its own tool in its own `ThemeProvider theme={studioTheme}` from v2 and never reads the Studio's v4 theme context, and both majors share the single hoisted styled-components 6.5.3. Do not try to force it onto v4 via an override: that stakes 26 v2 imports on v4 API parity for no correctness gain.
